environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, exposed directly via an Elastic IP on port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy or middleware in front of the Flask application. The SQLite database file is on a local EBS volume. Application runs as ec2-user with systemd unit file. CloudWatch agent collects /var/log/messages only.
